question.html:
A sealed box contains 1.8 moles of a monatomic ideal gas at a pressure of 7.2 10 Pa. The total internal energy of the gas is 7.8 kJ.

a. Calculate:

i. the temperature of the gas.

  [2]

ii. the volume of the gas.

  [1]

b. The kinetic model of an ideal gas is based on assumptions. State two of these assumptions.

  [2]

c. The molar mass of the gas is 6.4 g mol.

i. Calculate the magnitude of the impulse when a gas atom collides with the container wall. 

  [3]

ii. State an assumption that you made when answering question part (c)(i).

  [1]

d. The box is opened and x% of the gas atoms is released. Then the box is sealed and the temperature of the remaining gas atoms is raised by 48.3 C. The new pressure in the box is 40% of the original pressure. Find x.

  [3]

e. The temperature of the gas is reduced. Explain why a decrease in temperature causes the pressure to decrease. Refer to the kinetic model of an ideal gas in your explanation.

  [3]
